title: Telling a Story About Something That Happened
context: A good story has a start, a middle and an end, and small words that link them. You also use different past forms: the simple past for events, 'was -ing' for the background and 'used to' for old habits.
contextPersian: یک ماجرای خوب شروع، میانه و پایان دارد و کلمه‌های کوچکی که آن‌ها را به هم وصل می‌کنند. همچنین از شکل‌های مختلف گذشته استفاده می‌کنی: گذشتهٔ ساده برای رویدادها، «was -ing» برای پس‌زمینه و «used to» برای عادت‌های قدیمی.

expressions.persian: همه چیز از وقتی شروع شد که ...
expressions.example: It all started when I missed the last bus.
expressions.examplePersian: همه چیز از وقتی شروع شد که آخرین اتوبوس را از دست دادم.

expressions.example: A few years ago, I lived in a small village.
expressions.examplePersian: چند سال پیش، در یک روستای کوچک زندگی می‌کردم.

expressions.example: I used to play football every weekend.
expressions.examplePersian: قبلاً هر آخر هفته فوتبال بازی می‌کردم.
expressions.note: used to + base verb = a past habit that stopped.

expressions.example: We used to spend every summer at my grandparents' house.
expressions.examplePersian: ما هر تابستان را در خانهٔ پدربزرگ و مادربزرگم می‌گذراندیم.
expressions.note: Use used to + base verb for a repeated past habit that has stopped.

expressions.persian: وقتی داشتم پیاده به خانه می‌رفتم، ...
expressions.example: While I was walking home, it started to rain.
expressions.examplePersian: وقتی داشتم پیاده به خانه می‌رفتم، باران شروع شد.
expressions.note: was -ing = what was in progress when something happened.

expressions.example: Luckily, a neighbour had a spare key.
expressions.examplePersian: خوشبختانه یکی از همسایه‌ها کلید یدک داشت.

expressions.example: I opened the box and I couldn't believe it.
expressions.examplePersian: جعبه را باز کردم و باورم نمی‌شد.

expressions.example: In the end, we found the keys in the car.
expressions.examplePersian: در نهایت، کلیدها را توی ماشین پیدا کردیم.

expressions.example: Long story short, I missed my flight.
expressions.examplePersian: خلاصه‌اش این‌که پروازم را از دست دادم.

expressions.example: He opened the door... — What happened next?
expressions.examplePersian: او در را باز کرد ... — بعد چه شد؟

expressions.example: You won a prize? — Yes! — No way!

exercises.prompt: Choose the best form: "While I ___ home, I met an old friend."
exercises.explanation: was -ing for the longer background action.
exercises.explanationPersian: was -ing برای عمل زمینه‌ای و طولانی‌تر.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence talks about a HABIT in the past that has stopped?
options: I used to play football every weekend.
I am used to play football.
I was play football every weekend.

exercises.after: to live in a small village when I was a child.
acceptedAnswers: used

commonErrors.feedback: For past habits it is 'used to' (with -d).
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: برای عادت گذشته used to (با d) درست است.

exercises.after: when I missed the last bus.
acceptedAnswers: started
began
exercises.explanationPersian: It all started when … یعنی همه چیز از وقتی شروع شد که …

exercises.after: a neighbour had a spare key.
acceptedAnswers: Luckily
Fortunately
exercises.hintPersian: کلمه‌ای هفت‌حرفی که با L شروع می‌شود.

exercises.source: قبلاً هر آخر هفته فوتبال بازی می‌کردم.
acceptedAnswers: I used to play football every weekend.
I used to play football on weekends.

commonErrors.feedback: After 'used to' use the base verb: play.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: بعد از used to فعل ساده می‌آید: play.

commonErrors.feedback: It is 'used to' with a d.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: used to با d نوشته می‌شود.

acceptedAnswers: While I was walking home, it started to rain.

I couldn't believe it.
I could not believe it.

I couldn't believe it!

speakingTask.instruction: Tell a short story about a day when something unexpected happened.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: یک داستان کوتاه دربارهٔ روزی که اتفاقی غیرمنتظره افتاد تعریف کن.
modelSentences: It all started when I missed the last bus.
While I was walking home, it started to rain.
Suddenly, a car stopped and the driver offered me a lift.
In the end, I got home safely and I couldn't believe my luck.

roleplay.objective: Tell a short story in order and answer your friend's questions
roleplay.context: A friend asks you to tell a funny or surprising story from your life. Tell it in order, use linking words, and answer their questions about what happened next.
roleplay.opening: Tell me about the last time something unexpected happened to you!
